channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. warns shipping firms they could face sanctions over paying Iranian tolls in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US warned shipping firms they could face sanctions for paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. This could include digital assets or in-kind payments for safe passage, affecting about a fifth of the world's oil and natural gas trade.

item.title: Trump administration argues Iran war effectively ‘terminated’ before 60-day deadline for
item.description: The Trump administration argued that the US war with Iran was effectively terminated before a 60-day congressional approval deadline. This stance was taken to circumvent the requirement for congressional approval.

item.title: Iran executes two for spying for Israel
item.description: Iran executed two individuals, Karimpour and Bakarzadeh, for spying on behalf of Israel. They were accused of passing sensitive information to Mossad and collecting details on government and religious figures.

item.title: US warns shipping firms they could face sanctions over paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US warned shipping firms of potential sanctions for paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. Payments could be made in digital assets or through informal swaps for safe passage through the strategic waterway.

item.title: China urges reversal of UNIFIL departure from Lebanon as conflict escalates
item.description: China urged the reversal of the UNIFIL departure from Lebanon amid escalating conflict. The UNIFIL mission has faced growing casualties as Israel and Hezbollah continue to fight, prompting concerns over regional stability.

item.title: Spirit Airlines says it’s going out of business after 34 years and is ending operations
item.description: Spirit Airlines faces shutdown as government bailout time runs out. The airline is in bankruptcy proceedings for the second time in two years, struggling with soaring jet fuel prices due to the Iran war.

item.title: Iran Lost $4,800,000,000 In Oil Revenue Due To US Blockade: Report
item.description: Iran lost $4.8 billion in oil revenue due to the U. S. blockade. The blockade has significantly impacted Iran's economy. The loss is substantial, according to a report. A US soldier points a heavy-calibre machinegun at a vessel in the waterway near Iran.

item.title: US embassy warns citizens in UK as threat level raised to ‘severe’
item.description: The US embassy in the UK has raised its threat level to 'severe' and advised citizens to avoid schools, churches, and tourist locations, also varying their travel routes. The embassy did not specify the nature of the threat.

item.title: U.S. to withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany in next 6-12 months
item.description: The US will withdraw about 5,000 troops from Germany over the next 6-12 months, fulfilling President Donald Trump's threat. The withdrawal is part of a broader dispute between the US and Germany over the US war with Iran.

item.title: China's development offers a 'security dividend' to a fractured world
item.description: China's economic development is offering a 'security dividend' to a fractured world, according to a recent report. The report highlights China's growing influence in global affairs. China's development offers a 'security dividend' to a fractured world news. cgtn. com.

item.title: Hezbollah's Fibre-optic Drones Pose New Challenge For Israel
item.description: Hezbollah has begun using fibre-optic drones, posing a new challenge for Israel in the region. The drones are characteristic of asymmetrical warfare tactics. Hezbollah's use of these drones is characteristic of asymmetrical warfare.

item.title: War in the Middle East: latest developments
item.description: The conflict in the Middle East continues to escalate, with ongoing fighting and diplomatic efforts to resolve the crisis. The situation remains volatile and uncertain. War in the Middle East: latest developments Newsbug. info.

item.title: Why France abstained from UN vote on African slavery reparations. and why it matters globally
item.description: France abstained from a UN vote on African slavery reparations, citing concerns over the resolution's potential impact on international law and financial implications. The move has sparked debate globally, with many questioning France's stance on the issue.

item.title: US Military Reaches Deals With 7 Companies To Use Their AI On Classified Systems
item.description: The US Defense Department has partnered with seven companies to integrate their AI technologies into classified systems. This deal accelerates the military's adoption of AI, amid rapid advancements in the field.

item.title: Rats and weasels infest camps for displaced Gazans
item.description: Displaced Gazans are struggling with infestations of rats and weasels in their camps, which are spreading diseases. The pests have become a daily challenge for residents in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: Iran open to diplomacy if US alters its ‘threatening rhetoric’: Foreign Minister Araghchi
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi stated that Iran is open to diplomacy with the US if Washington changes its "threatening rhetoric". This signals a potential shift in Iran's approach to negotiations.

item.title: Trump Warns Of More Oil Disruptions, US Aircraft Carrier Leaves Gulf
item.description: US President Trump warned of more oil disruptions. A US aircraft carrier has left the Gulf region. US Israel Iran War Ceasefire News LIVE Updates. Trump Warns Of More Oil Disruptions, US Aircraft Carrier Leaves Gulf.

item.title: "Ceasefire Gives Additional Time": Trump As 60-Day Iran War Clock Stops
item.description: President Donald Trump told Congress that hostilities in Iran have terminated. President Donald Trump told top US lawmakers on Friday that hostilities in Iran had ended, after coming under pressure from Congress to seek authorization for the conflict as it headed into its third month.

item.title: Trump Approves Nearly $9 Billion Weapons Sales To Israel, UAE, Other Mideast Allies Amid Iran War
item.description: US President Trump approved nearly $9 billion in weapons sales to Israel, the UAE, and other Middle East allies. The sales come amid rising tensions with Iran. Representational Image. Trump Approves Nearly $9 Billion Weapons Sales To Israel, UAE, Other Mideast Allies Amid Iran War.

item.title: Germany's Iran "Humiliating" US Comment Costs It 5,000 American Troops
item.description: The US is withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany over six to twelve months. The Pentagon said the withdrawal was expected to be completed over the next six to twelve months.
